limitations: American physical assignment not modeled; intrinsic cash settlement is a research convention.
Missing OI, historical rate/dividend expectations and exact event timestamps. Provider IV/Greeks uncertified.

Event/panic filters and long-vol branch omitted; calendar scope 2010-2026.

rules.data: One processed snapshot series only; daily session alignment assumption, not synchronized intraday timestamps. No merged overlapping raw/greek series. Adjusted closes for RV; raw chain spot for strikes and breach. Missing spot/conflicting marks explicitly unavailable.
rules.entry: First exchange session of ISO week only, no later catch-up; no open position; earliest observed 30-45 DTE expiration. Signal at t, fixed contracts execute at next available session observation. No reselect/retry entry.
rules.execution: Atomic four-leg buys at ask/sells at bid; valid finite positive bid and spread/mid<=20%. Quote required for credit-based trigger must pass executable gate. Rejected close retries under existing engine; missing required mark fails. Terminal normal executable bid/ask close or explicit failure; expiration intrinsic cash research settlement.
rules.exit: Daily DTE<=21 OR spot<=short put OR spot>=short call OR executable gross liquidation debit<=0.50*gross entry credit OR debit>=2.00*gross entry credit. Fees do not enter trigger. Priority DTE, strike breach, stop, profit; record all triggers. No extra holding/reversal exit.
rules.hypothesis: Sell defined-risk short volatility when provider ATM IV30 exceeds causal EWMA RV by at least five annualized volatility points and IV percentile is at least 70 percent.
rules.iv: Phase 4A spot-ATM call/put mean, both rights; total-variance interpolation within positive observed tenors <=45 DTE; no extrapolation or local IV fallback. Provider analytics remain unverified.
rules.percentile: 252 exchange-session slots including current; at least 126 valid IV observations including current; strict comparison of current IV against valid earlier IV; nulls excluded from denominator; no forward fill.
rules.reporting: Independent funded runs, no combined portfolio. All prior observed data is development/debug evidence, never OOS or alpha. No tuning after freeze.
rules.risk: Retain central OptionsRiskLimits including max_credit=500. Positive credit strictly less than wing obligation. Loss plus normal round-trip fees <=min(1000,0.01*min(initial,current equity)); aggregate budget <=5% initial, stricter than canonical8%. Reserve full wing obligation plus round-trip fees from pre-credit cash; actual-fill recheck; one position.
rules.rv: Simple adjusted-close returns; recursive uncentered second moment seeded with first squared return; 20 consecutive valid returns; reset on missing session/invalid price; 252 annualization. Existing sealed Phase 3C inputs only, truncated causally.
rules.scope: Short-vol branch only; long-vol branch and undefined event/panic filters omitted with explicit user approval. No OI filter, no intraday/assignment/live trading.
rules.selection: OTM shorts nearest signed +/-0.20 within absolute [0.15,0.25], tie lower strike; smallest common outward listed wing width <=10; same expiration and underlying; choose identities before quote gate, do not search alternate widths for fills. One contract per leg.
